# `ArbitraryInterface`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\ArbitraryInterface`

**Interface** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/ArbitraryInterface.php#L24) — **Version:** working tree

**Implemented by:** [`Arbitrary\ArrayArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/ArrayArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\BoolArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/BoolArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\BytesArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/BytesArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\CharsetStringArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/CharsetStringArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\ClassArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/ClassArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\CommandSequenceArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/CommandSequenceArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\ConstantArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/ConstantArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\DateTimeArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/DateTimeArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\DictionaryArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/DictionaryArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\FilteredArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/FilteredArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\FlatMappedArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/FlatMappedArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\FloatArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/FloatArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\FrequencyArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/FrequencyArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\IntArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/IntArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\MappedArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/MappedArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\NullableArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/NullableArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\OneOfArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/OneOfArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\RecordArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/RecordArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\StringArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/StringArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\SubsetArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/SubsetArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\SwarmArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/SwarmArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\TupleArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/TupleArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\UniqueArrayArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/UniqueArrayArbitrary), [`Arbitrary\UuidArbitrary`](/api/classes/Arbitrary/UuidArbitrary), [`Swarmable`](/api/classes/Swarmable)

**Type parameters:**

- `TValue of mixed = mixed The type of the generated value`

Describes a space of random values with integrated shrinking.

An arbitrary produces a [`Shrinkable`](/api/classes/Shrinkable) via `generate`(): the
generated value together with a lazy tree of smaller candidates, each
carrying its own subtree. The property runner reads the value, and on a
failure descends through the tree, accepting the first candidate that still
fails, until no smaller value fails — yielding a minimal counterexample.

Because shrink candidates are attached at generation time, combinators such
as [`Gen`](/api/classes/Gen)::map() and [`Gen`](/api/classes/Gen)::flatMap() shrink in the source domain
and re-apply their transformation; implementations never need to invert a
transformed value.

## Methods

### generate()

```php
generate(Random $random): Shrinkable
```

Produce one random value from this arbitrary's space, together with its
shrink tree. Candidates must be ordered most aggressive first (typically
toward a zero/empty/identity element) and every branch of the tree must
be finite, so shrinking terminates.
